_provenance: Schema-derived fixture — GDELT lens RED phase. Shape derived from GDELT 2.0 DOC API JSONFeed specification (https://blog.gdeltproject.org/gdelt-doc-2-0-api-supports-jsonfeed/) and the existing gdelt_sentiment_api_shape.json fixture (Cycle 2). Values are test sentinels. The runtime validator (validate_artlist_shape) asserts each article carries url + seendate (contract hard requirement per .claude/gdelt-contract.md §3). No live GDELT calls in CI.
_note: Each article in 'articles' MUST carry: url (https://), title, seendate (GDELT format YYYYMMDDTHHmmssZ), domain. The producer maps seendate -> sources[*].seendate in the return dict. Tests assert shape/presence of these fields, never their specific string values.
